messages:
leo: Starting blue/green handoff for inference-gateway v3alpha -> v3 in us-central. Plan: 5m shadow, then 5% -> 15% -> 50% increments every 4m. Session cookie pin `rw-sess` TTL=30m. Graceful drain 2m per old pod. Release note: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-inference-gateway-v3
anya: 👍 I'll run synthetic probes, streaming probes, and watch p50/p95/p99 and error-rate. Probe script: `scripts/probe/region_probe.sh --region us-central --seq 512`
deploy-bot: deploy action started: routing-config apply (change-id: cfg-9002) -> enable-shadow v3alpha
sophia: Shadowing live. Initial warmup looks ok but longer-seq paths show p95 +12% vs v2 (cold warms).
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v3=5% (canary step 1)
leo: Seeing a small p99 blip ~08:14 UTC, +10ms; one 504 surfaced from v3 when probing long streaming path. Holding next step until we confirm.
anya: Digging into logs. Found upstream timeout in nginx for one v3 pod: `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` on path `/v1/stream`
ops-bot: infra alert: us-central-1b host pressure flagged (mem 87% for gpu-node-17).
sophia: Suggest tweak keepalive and worker connections in v3 nginx config; I'll push a quick configmap patch to v3 only.
leo: Go ahead, but do not increase traffic until we confirm the timeout is resolved. @deploy-bot hold next weight change.
deploy-bot: routing update requested -> HOLD (no weight change)
sophia: Pushed configmap `nginx-v3` keepalive=60s, worker_connections=4096. Rolling restart of v3 pods (2/6 restarted).
anya: After restart p99 for the canary dropped back to baseline, but one restarted pod reported OOMKilled during restart and returned 503s for ~30s. Captured container logs and oom event.
leo: Ok — exclude the problematic AZ from v3 routing while we investigate node pressure. Run a targeted weight update to route v3 away from us-central-1b. Command: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/internal/route/update -d '{"service":"inference-gateway","weights":{"v3":5},"exclude_az":"us-central-1b"}'`
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v3=5% (excluded us-central-1b). Old weights: v2=95% -> new: v2=95% (redistributed).
ops-bot: infra note: cordoning nodes in us-central-1b and scheduling evac. Opening infra ticket INF-1802.
sophia: We'll keep canary pinned at 5% and set cookie TTL 30m: `rw-sess=...; Max-Age=1800; Path=/` to ensure session affinity.
anya: I'll extend synthetic probe window to 30m and enable extra trace logging for v3 for the duration. Posting probes summary to the change window doc.
leo: If error rate or 5xxs climb >1.5x baseline, we'll rollback fully to v2. For now holding and monitoring. Update release notes with the partial AZ exclusion and keepalive tweak.
deploy-bot: deployment activity summary: shadow -> canary 5% -> paused -> config tweak -> partial AZ exclusion -> canary stable at 5%. No full rollback performed.
leo: Thanks team. Filing follow-up to hunt the OOM cause and reattempt a phased increase after node fixes. Closing change window early by 1h. Ping here if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
